feature_bullets: Dual-Sided + Temperature-Controlled - Scrub Mommy takes traditional kitchen sponges and scrubbers to the next level with her dual sided design. On one side, her FlexTexture foam changes based on your water temperature. Soft in warm water and firm in cool. On the other, spongy ResoFoam helps her create a soapy lather for wiping up spills.

Scratch-Free - Scrub Mommy non scratch sponges are safe to use on over a dozen different surfaces (i.e. glass, stainless steel, cast iron, non-stick coatings, copper, chrome, leather) so you can use her to wash anything from dinner dishes to the car!
Odor Resistant - Unlike other dish sponges, Scrub Mommy is dishwasher safe and built to resist buildup. Plus, when properly maintained, Scrub Mommy can resist odors and stains for up to 8 weeks!

Flexible and Multipurpose - You can use Scrub Mommy kitchen sponges for washing dishes and efficiently cleaning utensils, dishes, furniture, siding, sneakers, bathtubs and more! Anywhere there is dirt, grime, or gunk, these versatile scrubber sponges can help.

Ergonomic and Functional - Scrub Mommy is designed to fit comfortably in your hand and provide good grip and coverage so you can spend less time scrubbing and more time smiling. Her eyes hold onto you for a 360 degree reach, while her mouth cleans both sides of your utensils. No kitchen is complete without this cute and functional dish scrubber sponge.

top_reviews.title: Great sponges that last and don’t scratch
top_reviews.body: I’ve been buying these for years and still love them. They work really well for dishes and general house cleaning, and they last much longer than regular sponges. They’re tough on stuck-on food but gentle enough that they don’t scratch surfaces, which I really appreciate. Considering how long they last, they’re also great value for the money. Definitely a staple in my home.

top_reviews.body: I use Scrub Mommy Sponges in the kitchen. The sponge side is super absorbent, and the scrubbing side is very gentle, but effective on dishes, ceramic cooktop, and granite countertops.  Our Scrub Mommys can last from 3 weeks to a month.

top_reviews.title: Does a great job!
top_reviews.body: I really love these! I know they’re only sponges but they’re really great sponges! Two sided, cleans everything great without scrubbing, great for cleaning utensils, and they smile. I even bought a holder for it—you stick the eye holes on it! It’s the little things. :)

top_reviews.title: Good scrubbers
top_reviews.body: I prefer the rectangle versions, these round ones are kinda big for many dishes but they do scrub well. They don't seem to develop the rank smell that regular cellulose sponges do, and they don't scratch glass or pans. Absorbency is just OK (cellulose is better).

top_reviews.title: Best sponge ever!
top_reviews.body: I love these sponges! They work great for scrubbing stuck on food and the soft side is great for dishes that I don't want to scratch. Buying the 9 pack saves me so much money. The best part is these sponges are so durable, one sponge usually lasts me a month or so.
